question: **When did India first secure an Olympic team gold medal?**
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• According to the passage, India won its **first Olympic team gold medal** in **hockey** at the **1928 Amsterdam Olympics**.
 
• This marked the beginning of India's golden era in hockey, leading to eight Olympic gold medals between 1928 and 1980.
 
• Hence, the year **1928** corresponds to **Option 3**.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• **1900 Paris:** India’s first Olympic participation; Norman Pritchard won two silver medals, but not a team gold.
 
• **1936 Berlin:** India won another hockey gold, but it was not the first.
 
• **1948 London:** India won gold again post-independence, but the first team gold was earlier.
